description: Update an existing in-app product (title, description, price for one region, and/or active state).

active.description: true = activate the base purchase option (purchasable); false = deactivate it

currency.description: Currency code matching regionCode (required if priceMicros is set)

defaultLanguage.description: Language code for the listing to update (defaults to the product's primary listing)

priceMicros.description: New price in micros (requires currency and regionCode too)

regionCode.description: ISO region code the price applies to, e.g. "US" (required if priceMicros is set)

name: gpc_update_product
